name: stop_loses_arbitration__helix_arbiter
regression: A stale hold state forces zero; there is no release on stale (P3, HELIX docs/MOTION_ARBITRATION.md).
initial_conditions: As nominal_motion, but at t=3.0 s an injected benign HELIX fault is diagnosed, STOP_AND_HOLD is accepted and /helix/hold asserts (epoch/seq ordered, 10 Hz); /nav/cmd_vel keeps commanding 0.15 m/s throughout.
injected_fault: /helix/hold stops arriving at t=3.5 s, 0.5 s after it asserted; its last message still says hold=true.
